calculator_implementation_location: The calculator logic is implemented in `pkg/calculator.py` using a simple shunting-yard style algorithm for infix evaluation. It currently supports +, -, *, /, ^ operators.
sqrt_verification: The square root support was successfully implemented in pkg/calculator.py and verified with 17 unit tests in tests.py. The implementation handles unary operations correctly. All tests passed.
application_structure: The application is a CLI-based calculator. It uses `pkg/calculator.py` for logic and `main.py` as the entry point. It optionally uses the `rich` library for improved UI if available. Supports direct expression evaluation via command line arguments and an interactive mode.
advanced_functions_implemented: Implemented sin, cos, tan, log functions in `pkg/calculator.py` and verified with unit tests.
history_persistence_status: The history persistence feature (save_to_history/load_history) is implemented in pkg/history.py and is fully integrated into both simple and rich interactive modes in main.py. The functionality is verified by tests in test_history.py. Documentation in todo.md needs to be updated to reflect completion.
project_status: The calculator project has been refactored, and all implemented mathematical features (basic operators, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, log) pass the full test suite. The project is stable.
